categories.main_business_segments: Lanjian Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the intelligent logistics systems sector, focusing on the research, design, production, sales, and service of smart logistics systems centered on intelligent robots. Their product portfolio includes warehouse robots, shuttle robots, handling robots, picking robots, loading/unloading robots, depalletizing robots, and aerial robots. They also provide RaaS (Robot as a Service) operation, after-sales maintenance, and technical consulting services, serving various industries such as aerospace, photovoltaics, new energy vehicles, tobacco, e-commerce, pharmaceuticals, and manufacturing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes proprietary core technologies including advanced robotics, digital twin platforms, distributed ultra-low voltage DC servo conveyor systems, SLAM-based navigation, 3D vision recognition, and multi-robot cluster dynamic scheduling. Their production methods involve modular, series-based design with flexible manufacturing processes combining assembly line and point assembly to meet customized orders. They integrate hardware and software development, including embedded software, business application software, and intelligent algorithms for system optimization and simulation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Lanjian serves a broad range of industries including aerospace, photovoltaics, new energy vehicles, tobacco, e-commerce, pharmaceuticals, automotive, petrochemical, cold chain logistics, and manufacturing sectors. Their key customers include large enterprises in these fields, with significant sales to top clients such as TianSong Construction Group, Fujian Tobacco Company, and BYD Co., Ltd. The company also actively expands into international markets including Europe, North America, and Southeast Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Jinan, Shandong Province, and has expanded its presence internationally with subsidiaries in Germany, the United States, and Hungary. They have successfully entered overseas markets including Thailand, Mexico, Canada, Spain, Singapore, and established new subsidiaries to support global operations. Overseas revenue and projects have shown significant growth, reflecting their global expansion strategy.
categories.supply_chain_position: Lanjian operates mainly in the midstream to downstream segments of the supply chain, providing integrated intelligent logistics solutions that encompass system planning, hardware manufacturing, software development, system integration, and after-sales services. They deliver customized smart logistics systems directly to end customers, acting as a solution provider rather than a raw material supplier or pure logistics operator.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous innovation with a strong focus on R&D investment, which accounted for over 10% of revenue in 2024. Strategic R&D directions include advancing intelligent robotics technologies, digital twin platforms, multi-robot coordination, AI-driven logistics optimization, and expanding applications into new industries such as military logistics, smart manufacturing, medical health, and intelligent plant factories. They also emphasize global market expansion and talent development to support their internationalization strategy.
categories.revenue_model: Lanjian generates revenue primarily through direct sales of intelligent robot-based smart logistics systems, supplemented by RaaS operation services, after-sales maintenance, and technical consulting and planning services. The RaaS model involves charging clients based on storage and operational volumes with guaranteed minimum fees. The company uses a direct sales model focused on customized solutions tailored to client needs.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Lanjian is positioned as a leading domestic player in China's intelligent logistics systems market, recognized for its comprehensive product chain from hardware to software and system integration. While the global market is dominated by established players from Europe, Japan, and the US, Lanjian competes effectively in China with superior customization and cost advantages. The company holds a strong market position with significant import substitution capability and growing international competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Lanjian achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.21 billion, representing a 23.8% year-over-year increase, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 112 million, a 1.48% increase. The company’s total assets reached nearly RMB 1.95 billion, growing 20.26% from the previous year. Cash flow from operations improved significantly to RMB 214.6 million. The company maintains a stable growth trajectory supported by increased R&D investment and expanding order backlog.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Lanjian differentiates itself through its integrated smart logistics solutions combining proprietary intelligent robotics hardware, advanced software including digital twin simulation, and comprehensive system integration capabilities. Their ability to rapidly customize solutions to diverse industry needs, coupled with strong R&D and innovation, enables high efficiency, flexibility, and cost-effectiveness. The company emphasizes high-quality service, fast response to customer demands, and continuous technological advancement to maintain competitive advantage.
